modules.title: Introduction to Computer Applications in Society
modules.html:
How computers are used in education, banking, health and agriculture. This section covers introduction to computer applications in society.

Key points

  • The shortcut key to 'Undo' the last action in most Windows applications is... — Ctrl + Z.
  • The process of starting or restarting a computer is known as _____. — Booting.
  • Which computer generation introduced the use of Integrated Circuits (ICs) — Third.
  • The main circuit board of a computer is the _____. — Motherboard.
  • A program that manages all the other programs in a computer is the _____. — Operating System.

Worked examples

Q: The shortcut key to 'Undo' the last action in most Windows applications is...
A: Ctrl + Z — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ctrl + Z.

Q: The process of starting or restarting a computer is known as _____.
A: Booting — Booting is the initial set of operations that a computer system performs when electrical power is switched on.

quiz.q: The shortcut key to 'Undo' the last action in most Windows applications is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ctrl + Z.

quiz.q: The process of starting or restarting a computer is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Booting is the initial set of operations that a computer system performs when electrical power is switched on.

quiz.q: Which computer generation introduced the use of Integrated Circuits (ICs)?
quiz.solution: The third generation (1964-1971) replaced transistors with Integrated Circuits, which increased speed and efficiency.

quiz.q: The main circuit board of a computer is the _____.
quiz.solution: The motherboard is the primary printed circuit board that connects all components of a computer system.

quiz.q: A program that manages all the other programs in a computer is the _____.
quiz.solution: The OS acts as an intermediary between the user and the computer hardware.

quiz.q: The 'logical' part of a computer that you cannot touch is _____.
quiz.solution: Software consists of instructions and data that tell the hardware how to work.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a portable computer?
quiz.solution: Tablets and laptops are designed to be easily carried and used in various locations.

quiz.q: A computer network spanning across a country or the world is a _____.
quiz.solution: Wide Area Network (WAN) connects LANs over long distances using leased telecommunication lines or satellites.

quiz.q: Who is the father of the computer?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Charles Babbage.

quiz.q: The physical parts of a computer are:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Hardware.

quiz.q: The process of starting a computer is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Booting.

quiz.q: A computer virus is a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Program.

quiz.q: The brain of the computer:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: CPU.

quiz.q: Which type of memory is non-volatile and contains the permanent start-up instructions for the computer?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: ROM.

quiz.q: The volatile memory of the computer is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: RAM.

quiz.q: Software that damages the computer is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Malware.

quiz.q: The main circuit board of the computer is the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Motherboard.

quiz.q: Computer Brain:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: CPU.

quiz.q: Browser example:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Chrome.

quiz.q: In a spreadsheet, the intersection of a row and a column is called a...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Cell.

quiz.q: A graphical representation of the steps in an algorithm is a...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Flowchart.

quiz.q: A specialized program used to view web pages is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Browser.

quiz.q: Which is an output device?

quiz.q: Spreadsheet:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Excel.

quiz.q: Ctrl+V:

quiz.q: Flowchart:

quiz.q: VGA:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Video.

quiz.q: Types of Software:
